short_description: A state benefits agency is missing the 30-day SNAP standard in a rural county hit by a mill closure. A caseworker workbench (Databricks App on Lakebase) reads every verification document with AI Functions, checks each SNAP/Medicaid rule with CFR citations, asks the policy manual (searched by the Genie agent), drafts a plain-language notice in the resident's language and records the caseworker's decision; the director sees timeliness, backlog and equity by county in an AI/BI dashboard and Genie.
